entry.name: GapMm
entry.label: Distance between the picture areas of neighbouring screens, in millimetres

entry.name: UnitMm
entry.label: Size of one game unit on screen, in millimetres (at 16.3 a 476 mm wide monitor shows one game screen)

entry.name: SceneId
entry.label: "world" for the aquarium from tools/world.py, or a scene baked by tools/bake.py

entry.name: NightUntil
entry.label: The night lasts until this time (HH:MM), then dawn; with DayFrom, DayUntil and NightFrom (all four, in order), these hours replace the sun's

entry.name: DayFrom
entry.label: Day from this time (HH:MM), after dawn

entry.name: DayUntil
entry.label: Day until this time (HH:MM), then the golden hour and dusk

entry.name: Motion
entry.label: How often everything moves: 0 every frame on every screen; paced (less work): 1 every frame where Hornet is, 2 thirty times a second where she rests, 3 each screen at the rate of what it shows

entry.name: PauseWhen
entry.label: On the desktop only (never on the lock screen), stand still: 0 never, 1 while a window is maximized or full screen on that screen, 2 while any window is focused
